def conv3d_leakyrelu_add_clamp_gelu_kernel(

    x_ptr, w_ptr, sum_tensor_ptr, output_ptr,
    # Matrix dimensions

    offs_out_c = start_out_c + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_OUT_C)

    offs_h = start_h + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_H)
    offs_w = start_w + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_W)

    mask_batch = offs_batch < batch_size

    mask_h = offs_h < out_h

        self.out_channels = out_channels
